title: His-tag Ni-NTA affinity purification with TEV tag removal and reverse IMAC
summary: Capture a His6-tagged protein from clarified lysate on a Ni-NTA (HisTrap HP) column with an imidazole gradient, exchange buffer, cleave the tag with His6-TEV protease overnight, and pass over Ni-NTA again to recover untagged protein. Worked example from a crystallography paper.

steps.text: Lyse the pelleted cells and clarify the lysate by high-speed centrifugation (method not detailed in the source).

duration_s.note: Lysis plus clarification spin; not stated in source, ~1 h assumed.

steps.text: Load the clarified lysate onto a HisTrap HP Ni-NTA column.
Wash, then elute the tagged protein with an imidazole gradient; the target came off at roughly 100-125 mM imidazole.
Desalt the eluate on a HiPrep Sephadex G-25 column into the expression buffer to remove imidazole.
Add His6-TEV protease and incubate overnight at 4 C to cut off the tag.
Run the digest over Ni-NTA again; the untagged target flows through or elutes at low imidazole (10-20 mM) while tag and protease stay bound.

equipment.name: Chromatography system (AKTA class; the paper names the columns, not the instrument)

safety: High-pressure cell disruptors need guarding and pressure release before servicing.
Chromatography buffers with TCEP/imidazole: wear gloves and eye protection.
notes: Catalog mapping to AKTA pure is the pipeline's assumption; the source only lists columns and buffers. Lysis details and step durations are not in the source.
